title: Library set load/fail matched by set_id from the purpose, not the RequestId held in SetLoad::Loading
trigger: Panel asks a set (Loading(r1)); set is removed and asked again (Loading(r2)); r1 then errors
effect: fail() flips the re-asked set to Failed while r2 is still in flight (blank section until the panel reopens, or r2 lands and overwrites); accept_library_set inserts any request's answer
fix: fail(set_id, request) / accept(set_id, request) compare against SetLoad::Loading(request) like MessageReactionBook::waits_for

title: SavedMessagesState::note is a one-shot slot that nothing writes, reads or clears
trigger: grep of `saved.note` across src finds no writer or reader
effect: none today; a refused Saved action has no line, and a future writer would have nothing that clears it on sublist change
fix: delete it, or fold the refusal into the sublist/tag-search stage that asked

title: Session draft_dirty set and the driver's pending_draft are two marks kept in step by hand
trigger: Type in a composer (mark_draft_dirty), then a send error / cancel path that takes pending_draft without clearing the slot's mark (connect/composer.rs keep_failed_draft, draft_matches branch)
effect: a slot left dirty ignores every remote draft for that chat/topic until the user types there again
fix: one DraftSlot stage per (chat,topic): Clean / Unsaved{held: HeldDraft} so the mark lives in the held draft

title: GetStoryAlbumStories page is appended without matching a request held by the album list
trigger: Open an album (page asked), then add/remove/reorder a story in it; the mutation's ok removes album_stories[(chat,album)] and a page asked before the change answers after
effect: the late page recreates the list from pre-change ids (removed story reappears, no refetch) until the album is reopened
fix: album_stories entry as Fetch/Paged holding the RequestId; mutation outdates it so the old page is dropped

title: MemberList::more is only meaningful while fetch is Loaded and is reset by hand at six sites
trigger: set_member_fetch, members_changed, accept first page, forget_member_more, rearm_failed_member_more and note_member_more each write `more` beside `fetch` (domains/groups/member_lists.rs 29,49,158,189,204,238)
effect: none today; a new writer of `fetch` that forgets `more` leaves an Asking{request} stage beside a Stale/Failed first page
fix: move the next-page stage into SupergroupMembersFetch::Loaded { members, total_count, more: MoreMembers }

title: group_admin_busy is derived by scanning the request table for purpose+chat, not from a stage holding the RequestId
trigger: Any group-admin toggle for the chat whose request is lost or answered under another window; mutations are never swept (is_sweepable excludes them)
effect: dialog rows stay disabled while any request of those 11 purposes for the chat exists; a lost mutation keeps them disabled until logout
fix: GroupAdminOp stage per chat holding the RequestId, settled by answer/error/lost

title: History page 'in flight' is derived from the request table by purpose + chat + window_epoch counter
trigger: history_loading / history_page_in_flight scan ids_for_chat(WINDOW_PURPOSES) and compare Correlation::HistoryPage.window_epoch
effect: no bug found; the window stage does not hold its page request, so epoch and the table must agree and a swept/lost request only ends the skeleton through the 60 s sweep
fix: WindowLoad stage holding Loading{request, edge} per end, like NewerLoad/OlderLoad already carry the failure

title: forget_screen_outcomes clears ~30 one-shot slots across five domains field by field
trigger: An account answers while in the background (payment url, link, forward result, notes); a new one-shot slot added to PaymentsState/BotsState/MessagesState/GroupsState without a line here survives
effect: none today for the listed fields; the list is the only place that knows which slots are one-shot, and calls.error, calls.group_call_error, payments.checkout note and the settings account_ttl/account_write error lines (all in logout_notes' note list) are not in it, so an error that landed while away shows as news on return
fix: one `Outcomes` value per account owning every one-shot slot, replaced whole on return to screen (as OnScreen/Farewell do)

title: ReplyTarget::Loading holds a getRepliedMessage request that the 60 s sweep never settles
trigger: A getRepliedMessage answer is lost (client restart of the request path, dropped envelope); GetRepliedMessage is not in RequestPurpose::is_sweepable
effect: reply_fetch_candidates skips the row (any entry means asked), so the strip says Loading… until the row or chat is pruned; Retry only follows an error answer
fix: add GetRepliedMessage to is_sweepable (the lost-request path then rejects it as a retryable error), or give Loading a deadline like Retry{until}
